name: Harini V
subtext: 2nd Year CSE Student building intelligent, full stack applications.
quote: You can't add days to your life, but you can add life to your days, and I intend to make every day count.

about.lead: I turn curiosity into code, and code into impact.
about.body: I'm Harini V, a second-year Computer Science Engineering student with a relentless drive to build AI-integrated full stack applications that solve real problems. From shipping contributions to open-source projects across a 43,000+ participant community, to engineering machine learning systems for sustainability, and competing among the top teams in national hackathons, I learn fastest by building. I pair analytical depth, shown by 300+ solved LeetCode problems and active contest participation, with a collaborative spirit and clear communication. I believe growth is built daily, and my philosophy is simple: make every day count.

contactStatement: I'm open to internship and full-time opportunities, as well as collaborations on technical projects. If you're building something meaningful, let's connect.
